newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - HARTWALL 8-MTH PROFIT SEEN UP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - HARTWALL 8-MTH PROFIT SEEN UP.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed an 80 million markka median
forecast for beverages company Oy Hartwall Ab's January-August
profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
Profit after financial items EPS
(FIM million) (FIM)
Median 80 3.70
Mean 86 3.98
Lowest 58 3.40
Highest 122 4.70
The results are due on September 26 at 1600/1300 GMT.
In January-August 1995, Hartwall posted a 42.4 million
markka profit.
For Hartwall's full-year 1996 profit, seven of the 10
analysts polled gave a mean forecast of 106 million markka
(range 93-155 million). The 1995 profit was 45.3 million markka.
The data was collected in the fourth week of September.
Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg,
Aros Securities, Carnegie, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM
Securities, Interbank, Opstock and Postipankki.
